properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 20 at 12:51PM PDT until October 22 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Hanford CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...There is an 80% chance of 4 inches or more of snow along the
Tioga Pass and highway 120. There is a 50-60% chance for four
inches or more of snow above 8,000 feet in Tulare, Madera, and
Fresno counties.

* WHERE...Above 8,000 feet in the Sierra Nevada.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Wednesday to 11 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Roads, and especially bridges and overpasses, will likely
become slick and hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snowfall will affect traffic across Tioga
Highway/Pass.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY IN EFFECT ABOVE 8,000 FEET FROM 11 AM WEDNESDAY TO 11 AM PDT THURSDAY

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 20 at 12:56PM PDT until October 22 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow above 8000 feet. Snow accumulations of 4 to 8 inches
with up to 10 inches along the highest mountain peaks. Winds
gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Mono County.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Wednesday to 5 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Wednesday evening and Thursday morning
commutes.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 11 AM WEDNESDAY TO 5 PM PDT THURSDAY ABOVE 8000 FEET

properties.description:
* WHAT...There is an 70% chance of 4 inches or more of snow along the
Tioga Pass and highway 120. There is a 60-80% chance for four
inches or more of snow above 8,000 feet in Tulare, Madera, and
Fresno Counties.

* WHERE...Above 8,000 feet in the Sierra Nevada.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM PDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Roads, and especially bridges and overpasses, will likely
become slick and hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snowfall will affect traffic across Tioga
Highway/Pass.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 AM PDT THIS MORNING

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 22 at 1:47AM PDT until October 22 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
* CHANGES...None.

* WHAT...Snow above 8000 feet. Additional snow accumulations of 2 to
6 inches with 8 to 10 inches along the highest mountain peaks.
Ridge winds gusting as high as 40 mph at times.

* WHERE...Mono County.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Thursday morning and evening commutes.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Brief bursts of heavy snow and locally higher
snowfall totals will be possible with any thunderstorms that
develop today.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON ABOVE 8000 FEET
